static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends, but has not yet shared Anxiety about finding a new roommate with them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no previous similar psychological problems; has not yet received counseling or psychiatric treatment
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to specifically describe emotions and distress; emotional tone leaning Anxious and negative; cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind reading, predicting the future, overgeneralization, personalization; acceptable cooperation with counseling

basic_info.main_problem: Recently learned that my roommate is moving out, and I feel Anxiety about finding an equally compatible new roommate. This Anxiety began when the roommate announced moving out; initially very stressful, worrying about not finding a similar person, gradually developing into persistent worry about finding a new roommate and feeling Loneliness if one cannot be found.
basic_info.core_demands: The news of the roommate moving out triggered strong Anxiety and Fear of Loneliness, so hoping to receive counseling support during this transition.
growth_experiences: Once worried very much that an exam would be failed, but the exam result turned out Good.

core_beliefs: I am unable to cope well with change; things often develop in the worst direction
Building rapport with people is difficult; good relationships are hard to obtain again

special_situations.event: Roommate announces they will move out soon; the living relationship will change
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot find a new roommate as compatible as now, my life will become terrible, and I will be very Loneliness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly rehearsing worst-case scenarios, intensifying worry to mentally prepare in advance, but not yet proactively seeking broad help or systematic screening
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never find a new roommate as compatible as now

special_situations.event: Thinking about getting along with strangers again and establishing rules
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the new relationship does not reach the current standard, it equals failure, and I cannot stand the gap
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Craving a 'guarantee' of certainty, raising screening standards to reduce uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Without a clear guarantee, things will go wrong

special_situations.event: Hearing negative stories others share about 'terrible roommates'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others have experienced terrible roommates, I will likely encounter similar or even worse situations
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses on the most negative cases to remind self to be careful, further strengthening avoidance and worry
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The new roommate will definitely be terrible; we will argue all the time

special_situations.event: When thinking of confiding in or seeking help from friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I tell friends, they will not understand either, and may feel I am troubling them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Choosing Silence, bearing it alone, not proactively using Social support

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain a stable, understood, and comfortable intimate/peer relationship, gaining safety and companionship amid change
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being swallowed by Loneliness, fearing intimate relationships worsening and falling into conflict and loss of control
defense_goal: Lowers expectations by presetting the worst, avoiding disappointment or being hurt
Maintaining Self-protection and distance (not seeking help from friends) to avoid possible rejection or not being understood
Pursuing certainty and 'guarantees' to temporarily ease Anxiety about uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable individual needing to be understood, prone to Anxiety in the face of change
object_relations.object_representation: Potentially unreliable / possibly conflict-generating new roommates

object_relations.self_representation: A help-seeker who does not want to trouble others
object_relations.object_representation: Friends who will not understand oneself, possibly overburdened

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores seeking support from friends or sharing worries
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing friends will not understand oneself and may feel oneself a burden (transference: projecting the inner sense of not being understood onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond briefly in an affirmative tone, such as 'they will not understand', avoid elaborating details, tone flat and try to Displace the topic.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing an uncertain future (finding a new roommate) and being invited to evaluate evidence and options
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Using others' 'terrible roommate' stories as reason, believing things will go wrong no matter what
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Citing external cases as evidence, tone firmly convinced, repeating the judgment that 'things will always go wrong', downplaying counterevidence.

manifestations: Roommate moving out triggering strong Fear of Loneliness
Worrying about not finding an equally compatible new roommate
Believing friends 'will not understand', avoiding help-seeking, further intensifying the sense of Loneliness

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Although having several close friends to talk with, choosing not to share Anxiety, bearing it alone
Not yet proactively seeking external support under strong Anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing friends 'will not understand oneself', accordingly avoiding contact and help-seeking
Attributing the inner worry of not being understood to others' attitudes

exception_events.target_problem: When facing an uncertain future (such as worrying about not finding a suitable roommate), the client typically Catastrophizes and experiences Persistent anxiety, believing things will develop in the worst direction.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once worried before an exam that it would be failed, but the exam result turned out Good, the facts inconsistent with the worst prediction.
exception_events.reason: Clues: possibly due to some preparation beforehand, handling the task step by step, and the real outcome being a positive performance, a deviation point inconsistent with the catastrophic prediction appeared.

positive_force: Good relationship with the current roommate, showing the ability to build and maintain Good Interpersonal relationships
Has several close friends, with potential social support resources
Able to propose more prudent screening strategies (stricter interviews, asking trusted people for recommendations)
Having had experiences of worry but Good outcomes, which can serve as counterevidence material for de-catastrophizing
negative_force: Significant cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, predicting the future, overgeneralization and mind reading
Low tolerance for uncertainty and excessive need for certainty (control fallacy)
Avoiding seeking help from others, Social support not yet effectively utilized
Sleep and appetite disturbed, further reducing coping ability and functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent catastrophic worry and Anxiety around finding a new roommate
antecedent: Hearing the roommate will move out
Thinking about the upcoming change of living with strangers
Comes into contact with negative stories about 'bad roommates'
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of Loneliness and low tolerance for uncertainty, accompanied by cognitive biases of catastrophizing and predicting the future
target_behavior.function: Gaining a false sense of control by rehearsing worst outcomes, trying to avoid the unease brought by uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep disturbance, Decreased appetite, Decline in work concentration, overall functioning impaired

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids sharing troubles with friends and seeking support
antecedent: Thinking about whether to seek help from friends when feeling Anxious
In situations involving talking about needing support
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind-reading-style prediction that friends will not understand, worrying about troubling others or being rejected
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential rejection or negative evaluation to reduce Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Social support not yet able to start, Loneliness and Anxiety maintained or even worsened
